zh: 圖 1｜依保護目標選控制
公開內容、搜尋索引、資料權限與服務設定，各自對應保護目標。
圖 1｜依保護目標選控制
公開內容
保留菜單、營業時間與正式窗口
文件另製公開版，檢查中繼資料
搜尋呈現
公開頁的 noindex 管理索引
讓支援規則的爬蟲取得指示
資料存取
驗證身分，再檢查每項權限
頁面與直接檔案下載使用同一規則
服務管理
盤點入口、更新軟體、管理退役
依需求設定網路與管理介面
依資料用途組合控制，驗收各自的效果。
圖 2｜觀察、推論、行動分開記
由直接觀察形成可檢驗推論，再指定經授權的處理與驗收。
圖 2｜觀察、推論、行動分開記
觀察 Observation
未登入時，測試頁顯示合成名單
記錄時間、來源、角色與取得方法
推論 Inference
公開存取與內部測試用途有落差
列目前可信程度與待核事項
行動 Action
由網站負責人修正伺服器端授權
另定負責人、期限與驗收方法
複核 Review
三種角色與直接下載路徑重測
以實際結果更新發現狀態
情境與角色均為合成教學資料。
圖 3｜原始資料與保管紀錄相互連結
原始檔受控保存；工作副本用於分析與遮罩；取得、交付與操作另留紀錄。
圖 3｜原始資料與保管紀錄相互連結
取得與識別
發現編號、來源、取得人、時間與時區
記錄授權範圍及取得方式
保存原始資料
受控位置、原始檔案、SHA-256
摘要用於核對位元組一致性
建立工作副本
另存分析與遮罩版
保留副本與原檔的關聯及處理方式
追蹤保管與使用
誰、何時、做什麼、目的與位置
依程序管理權限、期限與交付
公開報告用遮罩版；原始資料依授權保存。
圖 4｜改善有成果，結案有驗收
F-008 由待查核到已驗收，保留變更、角色測試與實際結果。
圖 4｜改善有成果，結案有驗收
待查核
確認來源、現況與授權
把第三方聲稱列為待核線索
已確認待處理
記錄用途落差、風險、負責人與期限
安排權限及直接下載路徑的改善
已改善待驗收
未登入｜一般員工｜核准測試人員
以原問題與同樣路徑複測
已驗收
保存時間、版本與每項實際結果
外部副本與後續複查另行追蹤
每次狀態改變都有紀錄；新問題重新開啟。
en: 1 | Match controls to protection goals
Public content, search indexing, access permissions and service settings each serve a protection goal.
1 | Match controls to protection goals
Public content
Keep menus, hours and official contacts
Publish reviewed, versioned public copies
Search presentation
Use noindex to manage public-page indexing
Let supporting crawlers read the directive
Data access
Authenticate, then authorize each request
Apply permissions to pages and direct files
Service management
Inventory, patch and retire services
Scope networks and management interfaces
Combine controls by purpose; verify each outcome.
2 | Separate observation, inference and action
Use direct observations to form testable interpretations and assign authorized action and verification.
2 | Separate observation, inference and action
Observation
A signed-out test page shows synthetic names
Record time, source, role and method
Inference
Public access differs from the internal purpose
State confidence and remaining checks
Action
The site owner updates server authorization
Assign owner, due date and acceptance checks
Review
Retest three roles and direct download paths
Update status using observed results
All scenarios and roles are synthetic teaching data.
3 | Link original evidence and custody records
Preserve originals under access control; analyze and redact working copies; record acquisition, transfer and actions.
3 | Link original evidence and custody records
Acquire and identify
Finding ID, source, collector, time and zone
Record authorized scope and acquisition method
Preserve the original
Controlled storage, original file, SHA-256
Use the hash to compare byte consistency
Create working copies
Save analysis and redacted versions separately
Link each copy and its processing to the original
Track custody and use
Who, when, what, purpose and location
Manage access, retention and handover
Publish redacted reports; retain originals as authorized.
4 | Verify remediation before closing
Move F-008 from verification to acceptance with changes, role tests and observed results.
4 | Verify remediation before closing
Pending verification
Check source, current state and authorization
Record third-party claims as leads
Confirmed; action pending
Record purpose gap, risk, owner and due date
Plan page and direct-download access controls
Remediated; acceptance pending

Retest the original issue and access paths
Accepted
Save time, version and each observed result
Track external copies and later reviews separately
Record each status change; reopen on new findings.
